proposed_facts.reason: Canonical wrapper signature matches the proposal and supplies NULL explicit position. The delegated constructor returns NULL before allocation when both placement sources are absent, propagates allocation failure, and retains the source JObj on success.

Verified placement mode 1, retained owner/JObj/callback fields, numeric collision-state helper, initial state-entry ordering and subsequent touch-dispatch installation. Physics follows the source transform; event dispatch checks owner and callback. Common state entry clears touched, supporting the stated lifetime qualification.

The wrapper unconditionally resets four hitbox slots and bookkeeping before state entry with policy 2. Common state entry installs destination callbacks, clears touched and invalidates hurtbox positions. Unlike construction, this wrapper does not reinstall the touch dispatcher.

Corneria's damage threshold invokes suppression on both cannon proxies. The gryorster caller creates nine joint-backed elements and uses suppression/restoration during their lifecycle. Replacing cloud-platform identification with a nine-element scenery assembly is justified. The inert-contact exception is explicitly preserved.

Verified unconditional xD0C=2, paired xD0C=0 with position-cache invalidation, and the scanner's earlier inert branch outside the state-2 guard. Neither wrapper assigns individual capsule state. The cited gryorster lifecycle uses both operations.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the .data fact and material-rendering link: the extended descriptor and TEV templates are declared in source, but neither exclusive compiled-section contents nor section placement follows from that declaration. Supported source-level rendering knowledge is retained.

Accept deferral of all five .sdata facts and the overlay-animation section link. Source proves the one-entry opcode-21 dispatch table and unchecked indexing, not compiled membership, extent or preceding bytes. The separate Ground alpha override is not cleared by overlay reset.

Accept deferral of all four .sdata2 claims. The C-level unsigned conversion supports the handler's data flow but cannot establish a compiler-emitted f64 bias, its exact bytes, extent or section association.

Accept deferral of the specific Klaptrap identification. Canonical grgarden code establishes a joint-8 proxy and timed animation, not that concrete creature identity. Generic Ground-owned interaction behavior remains supported; rendered names are not independent proof.

Accept supersession of the constructor type/state facts and state-entry wrapper fact. The proposal supplies the omitted missing-placement failure and distinguishes retained callback fields from the touch dispatcher that later state entry clears.

Accept supersession of the damage-suppression mapping/state facts. Canonical callers support cannon suppression and temporary deactivation of nine scenery elements, without proving cloud identity. State 2 suppresses the reviewed non-inert hurtbox branch, not every contact path.

unresolved: Compiled .data/.sdata membership and extent, preceding .sdata bytes, and .sdata2 conversion-bias type/value/bit pattern remain unverified pending revision-matched compiled evidence.
The grgarden joint-8 proxy's specific identification as Klaptrap remains unverified.
The alpha handler does not advance the command cursor; owner-command progress and actual opcode-21 stream behavior require confirmation. No demonstrated runtime hang is claimed.
The alpha operand is stored as an unnormalized 0–255 float; its eventual TEV numerical interpretation remains unresolved.
Retained Ground/JObj pointers require valid external lifetimes; construction does not establish ownership transfer or lifetime extension.

Existing role-based names and unchanged supported research are retained. Acceptance covers the five changes and examined contradictions, not a new independent audit of every inherited retained fact or link.

evidence.why: One-entry unchecked dispatch and Ground updater.

fact_dispositions.reason: Retain the owner-command adapter, dispatch name and alpha semantics. Opcode 21 is the sole locally valid index, not an enforced input restriction. The interpreter routes unhandled opcodes >=21; the local handler neither advances the command cursor nor normalizes its 0–255 float. Declared Item_GObj and actual Ground payload remain distinguished.
